messages:
Harper Lin: Quick thread 16  16 - proposing a compact remediation block + enforced checkpoints. We keep losing track of owners.

Owen Park: +1. Keep it tiny and parseable. fields: owner, due, failure_mode, regression_check, checkpoints.

Nina Torres: also require a "prevented_by" line so we know the intended guardrail. makes the heatmap useful.

Cal Patel: IC rotation note: 1-week shifts with a shadow handoff day. outgoing + incoming pair for 1 hour to walk open remediations.

Harper Lin: example block to paste into PM/ticket:
```
remediation: short summary
owner: Name (team)
due: YYYY-MM-DD
failure_mode: cache/auth/db
prevented_by: brief guard
regression_check: smoke-url
checkpoints: 36h, 7d, 30d
pm_link: url
```

Owen Park: If we require that in the ticket, a small bot can scan and schedule reminders + escalate after 36h/7d. I'll prototype.

Nina Torres: add verification:type = automated|manual so dashboard shows which items still need human signoff.

Cal Patel: comms cadence: IC picks at declare: options quick (initial/15m/30m/1hr/final) or steady (initial/30m/hour/final). ops-bot pins it.

Harper Lin: recurring patterns: tag failure_mode in every PM. weekly job posts top-5 heatmap to eng-leads. helps fund platform fixes.

Owen Park: action items: Owen -> prototype parser + reminders (due 10 days). Nina -> verification matrix and PM routing (due 5 days). Cal -> IC handoff one-pager and schedule template (due 3 days). Harper -> add block to current PM and enable 36h reminder (today).

ops-bot: Checkpoint scheduled: REM-2024-911 36h reminder (owner: Harper Lin) will post in #eng-oncall at 3160001560.

Harper Lin: thanks all, will follow up with a short sync after Owen's prototype.

Owen Park: I'll ping when the repo is ready.
